string-array.name: update_notes
string-array.item: ## Fixes
Fixed inconsistent structure between the folder hierarchy page and other category pages.
Fixed some lyric lines moving only halfway upward during the upward-motion animation.
Fixed stutter in the highlighted-lyric upward animation.
Fixed Lyrico lyric-source identification issues.
Fixed font-weight adjustments not taking effect.
Fixed electronic-noise artifacts that could occur when changing tracks in USB Exclusive mode.
Fixed sudden volume jumps when switching repeatedly between hardware and software volume in USB Exclusive mode, reducing the risk of dangerously loud output.
Fixed track-change fade-in/fade-out not working in USB Exclusive software-volume mode.
Fixed abnormal list track switching after repeatedly changing between hardware and software volume in USB Exclusive mode.
## Improvements
Improved status-bar hiding so it no longer changes page layout.
Improved the smoothness and presentation of lyric upward-motion animations.
Improved the overall structure, interactions, and transitions between category and detail pages.
Refined USB Exclusive hardware volume, software volume, bit-perfect, and gain handling for improved listening performance.
Refined lyric settings and redesigned the selectors.
Improved the USB Exclusive playback model for better stability during frequent track changes and long playback sessions.
Improved notification popups: they no longer use the system default behavior and can now be dismissed with gestures.
Rewrote the WebDAV protocol layer and expanded its functionality (thanks to Halcyon).
Updated the Lyrico API.
## New
Added “Particles” audio visualization with rainbow and white styles, energy-driven brightness and motion, plus optional vibration feedback for a more immersive effect.
Added progress-bar visualization options.
Added material selection for “Music Spine”: custom materials can be selected in Settings or globally; choosing Acrylic or Liquid Glass synchronizes the background with the existing material effect.
Added artist biographies and artist-cover viewing (thanks to Halcyon).
Added notification-popup support to material settings.
Added a “Dynamic Spectrum” progress-bar style.
## Notice
If you experience dropped frames, try disabling the flowing-light background or Liquid Glass to reduce GPU load and improve frame rate.

string-array.name: update_developer_quotes
string-array.item: “永远快乐”这句话，不但渺茫得不能实现，并且荒谬得不能成立。快过的决不会永久；我们说永远快乐，正好像说四方的圆形、静止的动作，同样地自相矛盾。在高兴的时候，我们空对瞬息即逝的时间喊着说：“逗留一会儿吧！你太美了！”那有什么用？你要永久，你该向痛苦里去找。不讲别的，只要一个失眠的晚上，或者有约不来的下午，或者一课沉闷的听讲，这许多比一切宗教信仰更有效力，能使你尝到什么叫做“永生”的滋味。人生的刺就在这里：留恋着不肯快走的，偏是你所不留恋的东西。
为什么说擦屁股的最后一下，并不是你擦干净了，而是它的颜色淡到你能接受了？生活也是如此，差不多就行了。你越往里抠越多，其实人生和擦屁股一样，不是擦干净了，而是看淡了。所以尽力了就行，剩下的就交给内裤吧。
人对旧事物的怀念是无解的。或许你认为你已经释怀了，但是提起那个熟悉又陌生的名字时，还是会恍惚吧？她之所以那么难忘，是因为你和她之间是不完整的：那份最后没送出去的礼物，那些没说出口的话，以及脑海里幻想的以后。最要命的是那些没发生的场景，总在脑子里自动续写。可惜没有以后了，也不会再见面了。后来我才明白，原来有些告别不需要说再见，它早就藏在每一天熄灭又亮起的屏幕里，没说出口的话都成了过去。
我的心里下着一场不停歇的雨。看似平静的表面下，是潮湿、沉重的泥泞。我不是不想笑，只是所有的力气都用来支撑这个快要垮掉的自己。世界很吵闹，可我听到的只有空洞的回声。我努力地抓，却抓不住任何温暖的光。也许，我只是一个困在深海中的人，拼命地向上游，却早已忘记了岸的方向。
最近被一个叫微信支付的盯上了，太有手段了。我吃饭扣我钱，我喝奶茶扣我钱，我买皮肤也扣我钱，动不动就扣我钱。你很会做局呀，你很会阴我啊，成天藏在网络里，有本事咱们现实碰一碰。我这个人不怕事，也不来事儿，也不怕来事。小小的老子要是真发威了，你后悔就来不及了。再搞我钱包，我真要来事儿了，收手吧你。
自在极意豪，我有幸进入过。那是不可求的机遇，当我沉浸其中时，不会觉得有任何问题。直到某天，可能过了几天，也可能是十年、一辈子，你的思绪突然回到当时情景，以一种不自主的状态，被以前的自己击中。这时才明白，我追求一辈子的自在极意豪，原来一开始我就会了。此后我不再追求，不再刻意为之，只追寻内心的感觉，放任身体，发掘内心本来就存在的力量。
